title.narrative: OECD DAC 2025-2026 Guidance on donor´s CSO work
OECD DAC 2025-2026 Policy och metodstöd för DAC medlemmars CSO arbete

description.narrative:
Key deliverables under the civil society workstream as outlined in the 2025-2026 PWB are:
1. More effective and impactful policies and practices to enable civil society and protect civic space in collaboration with the DAC Community of Practice(CoP) on Civil Society and line with the DAC Recommendation on Enabling Civil Society through:
- Providing policy analysis and technical guidance, support and peer learning to implement the Recommendation's three pillars (protecting civic space, supporting civil society, and incentivising CSO accountability)
- A multi-stakeholder learning and monitoring event (2025 OECD DAC Civil Society Days)
- Integrating the Recommendation's implications horizontally in DAC and OECD work
- Monitoring the Recommendation's implementation and expanded adherence
2. Strengthened dialogue between civil society, the DAC, informal and formal bodies and networks, and the DCD in line with the Framework for Dialogue between the DAC and CSOs through:
- Coordinating the annual DAC-CSO Dialogues and pre-H/SLM meetings between the DAC and CSOs
- Guiding and supporting additional thematic dialogues with informal and formal bodies and networks and the DCD
- Managing the relationship with the CSO RG

Insatsen inkluderas i OECD DACs Program of Work and Budget (PWB)2025-2026 under Intermediate Output Result 3.2 "Effektivitet och reformering av utvecklingssamarbetets system" och har som mål att möjliggöra ett öppet medborgerligt och demokratisk utrymme, samt ett effektivt civilsamhällesstöd och dialog".
Insatsen bygger vidare på tidigare arbete i OECD DACs PWB 2023-2024 och DAC rekommendationen från 2021 om att skapa förutsättningar för civilsamhällets bidrag till Agenda 2030 genom att underlätta för civilsamhället att fortsätta genomföra utvecklingssamarbete och humanitärt bistånd och att dialog mellan givare och det civila samhället fortsatt genomförs med utgångspunkt i 2018 års ramverk.

The initiative is included in the OECD DAC's Program of Work and Budget (PWB) 2025-2026 under Intermediate Output Result 3.2 “Effectiveness and reform of the development cooperation system” and aims to enable an open civic and democratic space, as well as effective civil society support and dialogue.
The initiative builds on previous work in the OECD DAC's PWB 2023 -2024 and the 2021 DAC recommendation to create conditions for civil society's contribution to Agenda 2030 by facilitating civil society's continued implementation of development cooperation and humanitarian aid and ensuring that dialogue between donors and civil society continues to be conducted on the basis of the 2018 framework.
